## Description

packages/ui exports the Medvya MUI theme (verbatim from Handoff, plus the `ai` palette via module augmentation and dark tokens prepared but off) and the clinical primitives: Button states (default/hover/focus/loading/disabled with count), StatusChip (ordered/received/reviewed/completed, icon + label), ProvenanceTag (AI draft · not reviewed dashed violet / Verified / Synced from HIS / Patient reported / Imported / Signed), Alert (critical/attention/info with words), TextField states, RecordingPill (REC/paused/declined), IdentityBanner (name, age, sex, MRN, DOB, allergies never collapsed, consent, encounter, SYNTHETIC marker). A storybook-like gallery page in web/clinic (/__ui) shows every state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Theme values (palette, typography, shape 10, spacing 8, breakpoints xs 0/sm 360/md 768/lg 1280/xl 1600, MuiButton minHeight 44 and no text-transform, MuiPaper 1px #DFE7ED border no shadow, tabular-nums in tables) match docs/02-design/components-theme-copy.md exactly.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every primitive renders all states listed in Handoff §1; no status is conveyed by colour alone (icon + text present, checked by test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Focus ring is 2px #2563EB with 2px offset on all interactive primitives.
- [ ] **AC4.** axe reports no violations on the gallery page; text contrast of tokens matches the Foundations ratios (≥ 4.5:1 for text).
- [ ] **AC5.** prefers-reduced-motion disables animation in RecordingPill/progress.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
